title: Verified polynomial-time batch generation for affine isolation queries
claims: AffineIsolationQueryBatch constructs a pinned polynomial-time generator of all prefix queries and their polynomial-time verifier.
For a source no-input all generated queries are no-instances. For a yes-input at least one eighth of the full typed seeds yield an isolated query.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against pinned definitions.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned reference checker where available. Otherwise compare source hashes with the submitted checker transcript, without awarding experimental Lean points.
